sources.name: Nimbus Cement plant register (FY2025-26)
sources.used_for: Plant locations, type, capacity, output, clinker flows, water source, coastal flag, asset value, revenue

sources.name: India national boundary, OpenStreetMap (admin_level 2)
sources.used_for: Map outline (simplified to public/geo/india.json by backend/pipeline/build_geo.py)
sources.note: Includes the full Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh (incl. Aksai Chin) and Arunachal Pradesh boundary as claimed by India.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Climate API (CMIP6 HighResMIP)
sources.used_for: Days per year with max temperature >= 40 C; annual wettest day (Rx1day) and its change to 2040
sources.resolution: Models 20-51 km, downscaled by Open-Meteo to ~10 km
sources.scenario: CMIP6 HighResMIP; per Open-Meteo, 'as close to RCP8.5 as possible within CMIP6' (high-emissions pathway). Single pathway, so no scenario toggle.
sources.caveat: Past years are model output, not observations. Values are not bias-corrected.
sources.request_log: backend/data/source/openmeteo_climate/manifest.json (exact URL, time, cost and sha256 per plant)
sources.version: Climate API v1, CMIP6 HighResMIP models

sources.name: WRI Aqueduct 4.0
sources.used_for: Baseline water stress (today), future water stress 2030/2050 by scenario (2040 interpolated), riverine flood risk, coastal flood risk
sources.access: Water Risk Atlas point-analysis API (aqueduct.wri.org/api/analysis), same point-in-basin join as aqueduct-4-0-water-risk-data.zip
sources.caveat: Looked up from town-centre coordinates. Future scores computed from raw ratios with Aqueduct's formula; 2040 = midpoint of 2030 and 2050.
sources.request: Water Risk Atlas point analysis, aqueduct.wri.org/api/analysis, one call per plant point (exact request not recorded in the supplied files; see raw/aqueduct40_README.md)
